The example earlier: first case about locking Apple devices was labeled "破坏计算机信息系统". That case involved remote lock, making devices unusable. The label used in examples: "破坏计算机信息系统". So likely answer is that.

Thus final answer: [罪名]破坏计算机信息系统<eoa>
